name: @saar/cms-api
//optionalDependencies: The argon2 native binaries, listed so the lockfile carries them. npm records an optional dependency only for the platform it installed on (npm/cli#4828), and this lockfile was generated on Windows — so `npm ci` on the Linux runner installed no binding at all and every test that hashes a password failed with "Cannot find native binding". Naming them here puts all three in the lockfile whoever regenerates it. Add a platform when someone develops on one.
